feeds.title: Volleyball Beach Ozark Blog
feeds.description: Keep up-to-date with the latest news, games, leagues, announcements, and deals for beach volleyball. Nothing is more fun than hitting the beach volleyball court with your friends and family. Come experience beach volleyball unlike anywhere else. Our facility has 10 white-sand courts designed for all levels of play from recreational and collegiate to professional.

feeds.title: Junior Volleyball Association » Beach
feeds.description: Junior Volleyball Association writes about beach volleyball in this segment of the blog. The JVA Vision is to be the premier organization to serve all the needs of the Junior Volleyball Community. We are the ONLY national association that is 100% focused on junior volleyball and the needs of junior clubs. OUR MISSION is to promote the growth of youth and junior volleyball through program and resource development, education, and events.

feeds.title: Mustang News » Beach Volleyball
feeds.description: Keep an eye on this section of the blog to learn more about beach volleyball in and around San Luis Obispo. Mustang News is the official student-run news source for Cal Poly students and the greater San Luis Obispo. Mustang Media Group which run the Mustang News brings the student newspaper, TV studio, radio station, public relations agency, and business operations under one umbrella.

feeds.title: Progression Volleyball Blog
feeds.description: This blog is for athletes in the Chicagoland area of all ages and abilities, and it informs you of the locations where Progression Volleyball will have beach volleyball clinics, leagues, and competitions during the entire year. All sports fans can enjoy a top-notch indoor beach volleyball experience thanks to Progression Volleyball.

feeds.title: Better At Beach Blog
feeds.description: Learn the techniques, strategies, drills, and workouts pro players use to keep themselves at the top of the game. I'm Mark Burik. I've been playing volleyball professionally for 14 years, been ranked in the top 100 beach players in the world, and even won the Continental Championship in 2015. I built Better at Beach so players have a place to go when they really want to take their game to a new level.

feeds.title: Volleyball Beach Blog
feeds.description: Volleyball Beach has become a great beach escape gathering place for friends of all ages to socialize, get a little exercise, and enjoy some fun in the sun! Whether you're a beginner or advanced player, bring your team - or we'll help find a spot on a team that's just right for you.

feeds.title: Deep Dish Beach Blog
feeds.description: The Deep Dish news feed incorporates all aspects of the Deep Dish Beach Life. We have a huge selection of articles on volleyball from the world's best coaches and players to local communities and clubs. Health and lifestyle play a huge part in Deep Dish and we bring you articles on nutrition, mental health, and exercise.

feeds.title: Beachvolleyball AU Blog
feeds.description: Beachvolleyball.com.au is dedicated to expanding the love for beach volleyball around the Sydney area. Centrally based at the iconic Manly and Maroubra beaches, we are an open community welcoming everybody from local to international.

feeds.title: Volleyball Ireland » Beach Volleyball
feeds.description: Follow this blog to learn more about the beach volleyball scene in Ireland. Volleyball Ireland is the governing body of volleyball in the Republic of Ireland that controls the activities of all Ireland's international volleyball teams offers a range of programmes from Beach, Indoor and Sitting Volleyball.

feeds.title: Volleyballmag.com » Beach Volleyball Blog
feeds.description: Follow us to get updates about beach volleyball. Volleyballmag.com is the leading source for volleyball news, covering all aspects of the game and accompanying lifestyle.

feeds.title: World Of Volley » Beach Volley
feeds.description: The following section of World Of Volley is dedicated to Beach Volley. WorldofVolley.com is a website primarily focused on monitoring the news from the volleyball world and as such has become an indispensable source of information for volleyball professionals, sports and volleyball enthusiasts as well as the world media agencies. The site has become one of the leading services in providing and sharing volleyball information from around the world.

feeds.title: Orange Coast College Pirate Athletics » Beach Volleyball
feeds.description: Explore this section of the website to stay informed about beach volleyball at Orange Coast College. The Athletics Department at Orange Coast College provides resources for student athletes to pursue their athletic and academic aspirations and works to equip student athletics with the skills, knowledge, and dispositions to become successful members of society.

feeds.title: Sand Soul Blog
feeds.description: Valinda has a true love for coaching and playing volleyball. She competed on the AVP (Association of Volleyball Professionals) Tour for 13 years, with many top 10 finishes, as well as has her USA Volleyball Sand Volleyball Coaching Certification. She served as Head Sand Coach at Mater Dei High school - finishing 3rd and 5th in the Southern Cal region.
